can_do.de: Anspruchsvolle Texte implizit verstehen, Sprache flexibel und praezise einsetzen.
can_do.en: Understand demanding texts including implicit meaning and use language flexibly and precisely.

summary.de: Deutsch stapelt vor dem Nomen, Englisch stellt nach: the rule proposed by the committee.
summary.en: German stacks before the noun, English places after it: the rule proposed by the committee.

explanation.de: Deutsch kann Partizipialgruppen vor dem Nomen stapeln: 'die von der Kommission vorgeschlagene Regelung'. Englisch vermeidet solche Linksattribute und stellt nach: 'the rule proposed by the committee'. Fuer verkuerzte Adverbialsaetze nutzt Englisch -ing (aktiv, gleichzeitig) und having plus past participle (aktiv, vorher): 'Having reviewed the data, we revised the model.' Passiv: 'Written in 1920, the novel still reads well.' Bedingung: Das Subjekt beider Teile muss identisch sein, sonst entsteht ein dangling participle.
explanation.en: German can stack participle groups before the noun: 'die von der Kommission vorgeschlagene Regelung'. English avoids such left-branching attributes and places them after the noun: 'the rule proposed by the committee'. To compress adverbial clauses, English uses -ing (active, simultaneous) and having plus past participle (active, earlier): 'Having reviewed the data, we revised the model.' Passive: 'Written in 1920, the novel still reads well.' Condition: both parts must share the same subject, otherwise you create a dangling participle.

contrast.de: Deutsch: erweiterte Attribute vor dem Nomen, Partizip I und II. Englisch: Nachstellung (proposed by ...), -ing und having done fuer verkuerzte Adverbialsaetze, Subjektgleichheit ist Pflicht.
contrast.en: German: extended attributes before the noun, participles I and II. English: postmodification (proposed by ...), -ing and having done for reduced adverbial clauses, shared subject is obligatory.

examples.de: Die von der Kommission vorgeschlagene Regelung trat 2020 in Kraft.
examples.en: The rule proposed by the committee came into force in 2020.

examples.de: Nachdem wir die Daten geprueft hatten, ueberarbeiteten wir das Modell.
examples.en: Having reviewed the data, we revised the model.

examples.de: Da sie muede war, ging sie frueh ins Bett.
examples.en: Being tired, she went to bed early.

pitfall.wrong: Walking down the street, the house came into view.
pitfall.correct: Walking down the street, I saw the house.

why.de: Das Partizip braucht dasselbe Subjekt wie der Hauptsatz, sonst haengt es in der Luft (dangling participle).
why.en: The participle must share the subject of the main clause, otherwise it dangles.

task.de: Verkuerze: 'After she had submitted the report, she took a break.'
task.en: Reduce: 'After she had submitted the report, she took a break.'

quick_check.solution: Having submitted the report, she took a break.
accepted: After submitting the report, she took a break.

exam_focus.de: C1 Advanced Schreiben: dichte, formale Satzstrukturen ohne Wiederholung von because/after.
exam_focus.en: C1 Advanced writing: dense formal structures without repeating because/after.
